verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a Rollbar staff comment that customer credentials for third-party integrations, including GitHub and JIRA, are stored encrypted. That implies a Jira/GitHub integration exists but says nothing about linking errors to tickets or syncing status. Generic webhooks offer a do-it-yourself path, and the documented Active/Resolved statuses give something a sync could target. Missing for 10: documented error-to-ticket linking, two-way status sync (ticket closed resolves the error), regression reopening the linked ticket, any Linear or GitHub Issues integration docs, and independent corroboration.
